style_instructions: An experienced operator is speaking naturally to one smart peer, already midway through a real conversation. Speak the text exactly as written, without additions, omissions, repetition, or paraphrase. Keep the delivery calm, connected, and matter-of-fact. Read the opening as one continuous sentence with no singled-out word. Let breath, pace, and emphasis follow whole thoughts rather than individual words or punctuation. Keep sentence breaks brief and unforced; do not add dramatic silence. Underplay the dry humor and let the business idea emerge with quiet curiosity. Natural American speech. Avoid broadcast or stage delivery. Pronounce "2022" as "twenty twenty-two." Do not vocalize these directions.
